_doc: Hand-curated corrections applied by `waila-select` (src/bio_waila/data/select.py) on top of the registry. Sources: docs/data/audits/audit_*.md (metadata-only audits, 2026-10-06). drop = never select; route = replace download method/ref; labels = override dataset-level label targets {field: {mode, values}}; exclude_paths = regex of member paths waila-prepare/waila-download must skip.

drop.freehand-3d-ultrafast-doppler-brain-surg: IEEE DataPort subscription-gated; record lists no files; one complex-IQ HDF5
drop.biad3802-two-photon-calcium-v1-resolutio: BioStudies doi unsupported; 95 TIFF movies of 927 MB (82 GB) give about 90 images under the 20 GB budget
drop.sdt4d-simulated-two-photon-calcium: 28 GB of 687 MB simulated TIFF movies; budget yields about 116 noisy frames vs plan 2000
drop.acoustic-angiography-tumor-volumes: 13.9 GB zip whose pixels are .mat plus 2 npz; at most 8 images via read_array (also registry specimen should be rat)
drop.3d-ulm-nhp-brain-xing-2025: ULM microbubble density volumes; not MMBU-like 3D ultrasound
drop.3d-fulm-mouse-pericyte-zenodo-2025: ULM microbubble density volumes; not MMBU-like 3D ultrasound

drop.blood-cell-images-leukemia-sumith-2025: re-upload of PBC (Acevedo) + AML-Cytomorphology_LMU crops, both already planned; stain wright-giemsa is wrong for them (MGG)
drop.echoxflow: pixels are zarr v2 beamspace arrays inside per-exam tars (441 GB); no reader, B-mode not scan-converted, colour Doppler only as raw arrays
drop.darkfield-ir-slo-choroidal-nevi: Mendeley record fdnb2kyz4f holds only an 11.6 KB participant spreadsheet, no images

drop.fitzpatrick17k: redundant: 10 public rows, 16 permissive clinical-photography datasets; atlas-owned pixels, unlicensed HF VQA mirror with duplicate rows
drop.ead2020: redundant: same lineage as permissive edd2020/polypgen, 6 public rows, 24 permissive white-light endoscopy datasets
drop.derma-octa: redundant: 0 public rows, OCTA target met by permissive data, 5 filter variants of the same 331 skin scans
drop.octa-mosaicking: redundant: 71 images, 0 public rows, OCTA covered by 3 permissive datasets
drop.bbbc041-p-vivax-malaria: redundant: 7 public rows, Giemsa smears covered by 7 permissive datasets; Kaggle record lists every image twice
drop.leukocyte-tem-yolo-zenodo-5024988: false-colour (LUT) frames of one endothelial monolayer time-lapse; 4 zips of 43-45 near-identical frames of the same field; 'white blood cells' body part is misleading
drop.spinal-multiple-myeloma-seg: HF render has annotation overlays (vertebra colour maps / red lesion marks) baked into every slice
drop.cmha-intracranial-aneurysm-cta: only multi-GB .rar bundles (14.5 GB), not samplable
drop.bacteria-species-mother-machine-7: images are degenerate ~1:30 trap strips; mixed phase/fluorescence channels
drop.egid-gastritis: only .rar archives (3 x 5.5 GB); not samplable
drop.open-h-embodiment: robotics repo: matplotlib plots, phantom benchtop videos, wrist-camera views; no consistent medical imaging labels
drop.rsna-pneumonia-severity-3level: redundant re-split of RSNA 2018 pneumonia images (same source as rsna-pneumonia-2018)
drop.irradiated-cell-foci-2026: 446 single-nucleus crops of ~3 KB, all below the minimum size; nothing survives prepare
drop.intel-mobileodt-refined-766: preprocessed .npy stacks (4 grey slices from 1.8 GB); use the original Intel/MobileODT images instead
drop.tb-sputum-ufam-figshare-plus-2025: all files are ~40x40 px bacillus patches; unusable as images at the pipeline resolution (alternatively add a min-side>=128 filter, which would remove everything)
drop.hcfmrp-covid19-lid: single 10.6 GB .rar archive; not range-sampleable (needs full download + unrar)
drop.asce-enhanced-cxr: all images are lung-segmented, false-colour enhanced renderings (ASCE), not natural chest radiographs; the same patients exist in raw CXR sets

drop.cryoet-jove-dl-training-data: HF rows are all-black images (35/35 blank)
drop.paviaatn-hacat-4channel: single 3.6 GB multichannel TIFF in a 2.3 GB zip (one file, <=4 usable frames)
drop.rat-retina-fluorescein-angiography-video: one short video; all frames blank or near-duplicates of mmbu-public
drop.pan-multiplex-nimbus: multi-channel multiplex arrays/masks in multipart zips; decoded channels are near-black/label-like (134 of 140 blank); MIBI subsets are not fluorescence
drop.plasmodium-4species-rtdetr-france-2023: 44 GB split zip (.zip.001-.005): not sampleable and not recognised as an archive

drop.curvas-2024: Zenodo zips use a compression method Python zipfile cannot read (NotImplementedError); add a deflate64 reader to unblock
drop.angiocad: images only in a 4-part .rar (16 GB): cannot be sampled
drop.han-severance-validation-a: only montage contact sheets of ~100 thumbnails each are public (no single images)
drop.micsim-fluocurv: simulation renderings; 993 of 1000 are near-duplicates of mmbu-public (6 left)

drop.chestx6: zenodo record 21880300/21880301 retracted and deleted by the authors (410 tombstone)
drop.mitoem: pytc/MitoEM zips hold only seg*.tif instance labels (no EM); duplicate of mitoem-2
drop.murine-cell-lines-phase-xiong: 243 raw frames are 98% near-duplicates of mmbu-public; 3 usable images
drop.cholecinstanceseg: Synapse-only authenticated download (unsupported host), CC BY-NC-SA; not fetchable by the pipeline (re-validated R3: still state=manual)
drop.hmu-crc-hist550k: figshare record exposes only ADI.7z (6.3 GB, one class of the 550k tiles); not samplable, single-class (R3: still too_big)
drop.idr0134-peters-bryophytes: IDR-hosted (idr.openmicroscopy.org), unsupported host, no scriptable route (R3: still manual)
drop.nsclc-radiogenomics: HF file sample is one patient (R01-027) of coronal DERIVED/REFORMATTED whole-body CT incl. table-only slices; labels chest/lung do not describe it; 10 usable images (R3)
drop.segthy: HF preview PNGs are vertically flipped (anterior down) and only 14 images; pipeline cannot flip per dataset (R3)
drop.periorbital-segmentation: identifiable celebrity/portrait face crops (privacy), not clinical photographs
drop.rectal-cancer-surgery-ochra: 75 surgical mp4s of 2.5-3.3 GB each (765 GB), no remote frame sampling

drop.renji-esd-egc: figshare 28045295 is a 100 GB multi-disk split zip (ESD.z01-z19) of videos; cannot be range-sampled

drop.axonem: HF repo = zips of .h5 EM volumes + seg .h5 only; no h5 reader
drop.transmitted-light-cellseg-aggregate-spac: HF imagefolder interleaves segmentation label maps with the images (3/8 samples are masks); names carry no discriminator; most files blank

drop.totalsegmentator-ct-idc-segmentations: radiomics feature tables + s5cmd manifests only; no CT pixels
drop.gomez-embryo-updated-labels-auckland: labels CSV only (figshare 27610557, 32 MB); images are in gomez-human-embryo-timelapse

drop.bvem: HF repo lists no media files or archives; streaming needs an unavailable module (volume format); verification run 2026-10-08
drop.hela-nuclear-envelope-sbfsem-gt: record lists no media files or archives (volumes only); verification run 2026-10-08
drop.isoorg-1k: HF yanchaoz/* (EMNeuron/OrgMIM): data only in multi-GB RAR archives of EM volumes; nothing readable in sampled archives (verification 2026-10-08)
drop.denspine-em: HF pytc/DenSpineEM: volumes only (streaming needs an unavailable module); no 2D images (verification 2026-10-08)
drop.isic-clonal-sk: unsupported host / manual download (ISIC archive API, collections 534/476)

drop.tcga-coad-ct: unsupported host / manual download (TCIA unsupported; collection timed out)

force_include.hyperkvasir: Likely source of 34 public rows (Kvasir-v2 style GI classes: z-line, pylorus, cecum, dyed lifted polyps, esophagitis, UC); CC-BY-4.0, HF mirror; not yet selected (only kvasir-capsule is). Also helps under-filled gastroscopy/colonoscopy.
force_include.edd2020: Likely source of 43 public rows (BE / suspicious / HGD / cancer / polyp, boxes+masks); CC-BY-4.0, Kaggle mirror route; not selected.
force_include.nct-crc-he-100k: Source of ~81 public rows (9-class colorectal texture, 224x224, 0.5 mpp, H&E); CC-BY-4.0; not selected.
force_include.crc-val-he-7k: Companion validation set of NCT-CRC-HE (shares the Zenodo 1214456 route; pool dedup keeps whichever scores higher).
force_include.kather-crc-texture-2016: Source of 34 public rows (8 classes, 0.495 mpp, 150px tiles); CC-BY-4.0; not selected.
force_include.mendeley-lbc-hussain-2019: Source of 23 public rows (LBC Pap smear NILM/LSIL/HSIL/SCC, 2048x1536 -> 512x384, Papanicolaou); CC-BY-4.0; not selected.
force_include.mias: Source of 35 public rows (7 MIAS classes exactly: calcification, circumscribed, spiculated, ill-defined, architectural distortion, asymmetry, normal); CC-BY-2.0; mammography has only 5 selected sets.
force_include.itobos-2024: Likely source of 10 public rows (total-body-photography lesion boxes: mole/lesion/scar/hair/specular highlight); CC-BY-4.0, figshare.
force_include.sbfsem-vero-sars-cov-2-mitochondria: Likely source of 5 public rows (SBF-SEM Vero cell, SARS-CoV-2 organelles); MIT; HF; adds rare SEM class data (label 'Vero cells').
force_include.kaggle-brain-tumor-mri-nickparvar: Plausible source of 4 public rows (glioma/meningioma/pituitary); CC-BY-4.0.
force_include.bccd: Plausible source of ~23 public rows (RBC/WBC/platelet boxes, 416x416 YOLO-style; Giemsa); MIT; not selected. Low-medium confidence.
force_include.octid: Plausible source of 4 public rows (OCT with macular hole / DR / AMD classes); CC0; not selected.
force_include.sicapv2: Plausible source of 8 public rows (Gleason level 1-5 patches, 512x512); CC-BY-4.0; not selected.
force_include.polypgen: Colonoscopy is badly under-filled (645 of 8,000 planned images); MMBU polyp segmentation rows (10) come from a Kvasir-SEG/CVC/PolypGen-type set; PolypGen is the only tier-A one; CC-BY-4.0, registration route.
force_include.mpox-hsam-6class: Plausible source of 5 public rows (monkeypox/cowpox/chickenpox/measles/smallpox/healthy skin photos); CC-BY-4.0; low weight.
